messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They say "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" That seems like they want to compute the standard error or maybe the critical value? Actually phrase: "以得到人口平均值為98.6" means "to get population mean as 98.6". Might be computing z-score difference between sample and hypothesized population mean.

We can use formula: (sample_mean - population_mean) / (sample_std_dev/sqrt(sample_size)). Compute this. Then we might need p-value using normal distribution. But tool only calculates p-value given sample mean etc. We could call it with those values. Provide result. Let's do calculation manually first:

Difference = 98.2 - 98.6 = -0.4. Standard error SE = 1.4/ sqrt(40). sqrt(40)=6.3249; SE=1.4/6.3249≈0.2215. Z = diff/SE ≈ -0.4/0.2215=-1.805. For one-sided test if alternative less than? Two-tailed would double tail probability. P(Z <= -1.805) ~ 0.0357. So two-tailed p~0.0714. Use python's stats? We'll just provide approximate.

But better to use tool to compute p-value. Need sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40. Call function.
